name: Everest Driveways & Patios
website: none working - the domain listed on its own profile (everestdriveways.com) does not resolve
what_they_do: Concrete and hardscape contractor doing driveways, concrete patios, walks and steps for New Brunswick area homeowners. Offers free estimates according to a HomeAdvisor listing. Registered trucking entity (USDOT 3823728 'Everest Driveways and Patios Corp'), fully open Mon-Sat 7am-7pm per its listing.
customers: Homeowners (driveways, patios, walkways); presumably some commercial given the corp/trucking registration.

size_signals.signal: 5.0 stars from 395 reviews - by far the highest review volume in this batch
Directory reports NJ contractor registration expired/last verified May 15, 2026 - unverified claim, worth confirming

website_review.out_of_date_signs: The website URL shown on its directory profile (everestdriveways.com) returns ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED - the brand's domain has lapsed
website_review.search_basics: No website, so no page titles, service pages or town pages; all discoverability rests on third-party directories
top_issues: Dead website: the listed domain does not resolve at all
No owned pages to rank for 'driveways New Brunswick' despite 395 reviews
No quote form or booking; demand is phone/directory only
No visible licence number on any owned property (because none exists)

agent_readiness.notes: Unclaimed profile; hours and category are listed but no services detail, no photos verified, no schema and no site to hold robots.txt. Nothing to submit a quote request to except a phone call.

operations_signals.signal: 395 reviews with no owned website or intake form means all that demand converts through phone calls during a 7-7 window
Directory-stated licence lapse (expired 2026) would create paperwork/renewal admin if accurate - unverified

top_opportunities.opportunity: Relaunch a small site on the existing domain with services, service area, licence, reviews and a quote form with photo upload
top_opportunities.evidence: everestdriveways.com returns ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED while the business holds 395 reviews

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim the Google profile and publish hours, services and photos so agents and Maps can read it
top_opportunities.evidence: Profile is unclaimed with only category and hours

top_opportunities.opportunity: AI phone/quote intake + review request automation on top of existing volume
top_opportunities.evidence: No digital intake at all; 395-review volume shows steady job flow

scores.reasons: A verified, high-volume paving business with literally no working website is the clearest gap in the batch; driveway/patio jobs are mid-size tickets; building a small site is quick; confidence limited by not being able to read actual reviews or licence status.
